scripts.verify: npm run verify:server && npm run verify:client
scripts.verify:server: esbuild scripts/verify-sync.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=scripts/.verify-sync.mjs --log-level=warning && node scripts/.verify-sync.mjs && rm -f scripts/.verify-sync.mjs
scripts.verify:client: esbuild scripts/verify-client.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=scripts/.verify-client.mjs --log-level=warning && node scripts/.verify-client.mjs && rm -f scripts/.verify-client.mjs
